transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Alvarez, the Battalion S-6. I'll be publishing the binding network access plan for tomorrow's three service windows after we go through the change-control board. Before I can finalize segment and window assignments for the command video brief, the logistics synchronization feed, and the clinic records system, I need each of you to provide your service requirements. I also need to confirm that each service will have its documented configuration control completed before its assigned access window begins. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to put this on the table now: the command video brief must use Segment Green and the 1400-1500 window. I received confirmation this morning that the partner headquarters bridge is configured only for Segment Green at that time. This hasn't made it onto the change-control board slide yet, so I want to make sure everyone here has it before we proceed.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to put my logistics requirements on the table now: the logistics synchronization feed must use Segment Blue and the 1000-1100 window. I confirmed today with the depot technician that the legacy terminal only accepts the Blue segment profile, and the depot upload begins at 1000. This hasn't been added to the network request yet, so I want to make sure it's captured before we finalize the plan.
